infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a profile photo for your card. Also used to scan others' QR cards into your rolodex.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a profile photo for your card from your library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Read your contacts to find Dynolabs cards you saved before installing this app, and keep them current as those people update their info.
infoPlist.NSContactsWriteUsageDescription: Save scanned cards to your iPhone Contacts and update them when those people change their info.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Remember where you scanned a card so you can find it later (e.g. "the people I met at TechCrunch").
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Match a scanned card to the calendar event you were at when you scanned (e.g. auto-tag with the conference name).

plugins.photosPermission: Pick a profile photo for your card from your library.
plugins.cameraPermission: Take a profile photo for your card.

plugins.contactsPermission: Read your contacts to find Dynolabs cards you saved before installing this app, and keep them current.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Remember where you scanned a card so you can find it later.

plugins.calendarPermission: Match a scanned card to the calendar event you were at when you scanned.
